intro: At Japan Day you will find sales, food and presentation stands dedicated to Japanese culture, food, drinks and traditional crafts.

items.name: Nagomi tea
items.description: Premium Japanese teas sourced directly from growers in Japan.

items.name: Nagomi sake
items.description: Presentation and tasting of Japanese sake.

items.name: Daniela Broučková Renčová
items.description: A presentation of work inspired by Japan.

items.name: Japan Whisky
items.description: A selection of Japanese whisky and an introduction to Japanese whisky culture.

items.name: Kumihimo – Japanese braiding
items.description: A demonstration of the traditional Japanese kumihimo braiding technique.

items.name: Matcha tea
items.description: Matcha tea and drinks prepared with matcha.

items.name: World Bakery 60
items.description: Japanese and Asian baked goods, cakes and sweet specialities.

items.name: Fujitsu
items.description: A Japanese technology company and partner of the event.

items.name: Nihon Bunka Plzeň
items.description: Japanese culture, traditional clothing and activities presented by the Nihon Bunka association.

items.name: GO Akademie Praha
items.description: An introduction to the traditional strategic board game Go.

items.name: Fakulta herní
items.description: Presentation of gaming activities and education.
